==Dates==
Date when she was raised to shawl is clearly wrong. At the begining of chapter 19 in crown of swords is written:

"The shawl had graced Merana's shoulders for over twenty-five years when Cadsuane announced her retirement from the world, her hair already solid gray, and everyone assumed her long dead when the Aiel War erupted another twenty-five years on,"

That means, that Merana was raised to shawl good fifty years before Aiel war (976-978)
:Fixed. Thanks for catching that! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:30, June 8, 2011 (UTC)

== History ==
A slight misunderstanding here. Most likely, Jordan mentioned the Falme Treaty to emphasize Meranas experience and tenasity, that the treaty failed is at most a red herring. Some conflicts simply cannot be resolved by diplomacy.[[User:Badrin|Badrin]] ([[User talk:Badrin|talk]]) 02:58, August 3, 2012 (UTC)
== Ambassador ==
Verin, worried that Meranas diplomatic skill would deliver Rand into the hands of Sheriam and the Black Ajah, but unable to pull rank (the exhaustive discussion of rank is probably a deliberate clue), sought to undermine her leadership - hence the "Aiel" attack and its aftermath.

Then decidedly undiplomatic Kiruna arrived and took over. [[User:Badrin|Badrin]] ([[User talk:Badrin|talk]]) 03:20, August 3, 2012 (UTC)
